name: Vault Guardian Gaoler
description: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.

abilities.name: Blocking Shield
abilities.description: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

abilities.name: Lock Up
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.
